visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @HahaTai. [Subtitle]: Can you describe life in the past three years? 您能描述過去三年的生活嗎？ (2) [Subtitle]: Not in the past three years... Like last summer, in July... 像是去年夏天7月的時候... (3) [Subtitle]: A massive attack to a power station near to Ukrainka, Bukhov. 在博基夫(Bukhov)附近的一個小村莊的發電廠遭受大規模攻擊... (4) [Subtitle]: It was destroyed, partially. I believe partly. 被摧毀了部分 我聽到是部分. (5) [Subtitle]: We lived without electricity a month... 我們過了一個月沒電的生活... (6) [Subtitle]: Me, my husband, my neighbors, we all lived on the 23rd floor... 我與我的丈夫、我的鄰居們 我們住在23樓... (7) [Subtitle]: Without electricity, without lift, no water... 沒有電、沒有電梯、沒有水... (8) [Subtitle]: It was really hard... 這真的很困難... (9) [Subtitle]: We had electricity but not all day... 那時候不是全天都有電... (10) [Subtitle]: But some maybe two hours per day... 也許每天兩個小時... (11) [Subtitle]: It was some competition for us... 生活上是個很大的挑戰... (12) [Subtitle]: Last night, there was a massive attack to Ukraine, not on Kyiv. 昨晚烏克蘭有被大規模攻擊 不是對基輔. (13) [Subtitle]: I and my husband all night was monitoring the situation. 我和我的丈夫整晚都在監視情況. (14) [Subtitle]: Watching where the missiles were, which direction of the missiles lead. 看導彈在哪裡 導彈的方向飛往哪裡. (15) [Subtitle]: Then in the evening yesterday, we were in the National Opera with the greatest concert. 然後晚上 昨天我們在國家歌劇院 看了一個最棒的表演. (16) [Subtitle]: I know it sounds and looks strange, but... we have such life. 我知道這看起來與聽起來很奇怪 但...我們有這樣的生活. (17) [Subtitle]: We try to live here and now. 我們試著生活在這 活在當下. (18) [Subtitle]: It's hard to buy tickets to theater to opera in Kyiv. 而且現在很難買到 去基輔看歌劇的票. (19) [Subtitle]: My husband last autumn was staying in queue about five hours to buy a ticket for the famous play "The Witch of Konotop" (Ukrainian classic opera). 我的丈夫 去年秋天 在基輔排了大約五個小時 為了買一個很有名的戲劇 《阿諾特普的女巫》(烏克蘭經典歌劇)的門票. (20) [Subtitle]: Five hours in queue. Hahahaha. 排了五個小時！哈哈哈哈.
